description: This file defines a Dropbox provider class with static methods for interacting with Dropbox API, including importing files, creating share links, retrieving files, renaming, and deleting files, as part of a larger application managing recipes.

classes.name: Dropbox
classes.description: A class providing static methods to interact with Dropbox API for file management within the application.

methods.name: import_all
methods.description: Imports all recipes from a Dropbox folder, creating RecipeImport entries for new files.

methods.name: create_share_link
methods.description: Creates a shared link for a given recipe file on Dropbox.

methods.name: get_share_link
methods.description: Retrieves an existing shared link for a recipe file, or creates one if none exists.

methods.name: get_file
methods.description: Downloads the file content from Dropbox using the shared link.

methods.name: rename_file
methods.description: Renames or moves a file on Dropbox.
